_note: scripts/tidy_vault_logs.py (vault tidy, Chuen 15 Nov 2026). Paths under folders/rename_in/root are vault-relative; manifest_dir is repo-relative. The month folder pattern and the chat title rules are atrium/config.json "months" and "import_chats" -> "title" (the importer's own, so old and new notes are named alike). State files whose paths are rewritten are read from atrium/config.json (section, key).
_rename_in: Chat notes here whose first ask is a machine preamble (import_chats title skip) are renamed '<date> <source> <title>'.
_root: --root: these vault-root files move into dest. keep = root files left where they are, with why (an external tool reads them from the vault root). A file already at the destination is never overwritten: the old copy gets a ' (n)' name beside it.

keep.CLAUDE.md: not empty (a locked pointer note) and Claude Code reads CLAUDE.md from the folder it is started in
keep.GEMINI.md: not empty (a locked pointer note) and Gemini CLI reads GEMINI.md from the folder it is started in

messages.counts: {moves} file(s) to move ({renames} renamed), {files} note(s) to edit ({links} link(s) rewritten, plus each renamed note's own name and H1), {states} state file(s) to update.
messages.done: Moved {moves} file(s), rewrote {files} note(s) and {states} state file(s). Manifest: {manifest} (undo: --undo "{manifest}")
messages.undo_done: Undo: {moves} file(s) moved back, {edits} note(s) restored, {skipped} skipped.
messages.locked: The vault lock is held by someone else; nothing was changed. Try again in a minute.
